body:
What you are printing is `{{ users | slice:0:1|json }}` 

You should add parents `{{ (users | slice:0:1) | json }}`

It sounds like a pain when chaining multiple pipes (which is quite common).
Couldn't the associativity be changed, so that it is possible to chanin pipes without needing paranthesis ?

@gkalpak exactly my thoughts. Especially that it works just fine in ng1.

I'm going to re-open this one, @vicb let's have some more conversation on this one.
@gkalpak :+1: We should have exactly syntax than the one we currently have in angular 1 !
Agreed, the parenthesis should not be necessary.

FWIW, the problem appears limited to pipes with parameters. This works fine: `
{{ title | uppercase | lowercase }}
`

issue.title: [BC BREAK] feat(Parser): associate pipes right to left

labels.name: feature
labels.description: Label used to distinguish feature request from other issues

issue.body:
closes #4605

BREAKING CHANGE:

Before:

`1 + 1 | pipe:a | pipe:b` was parsed as `(1 + 1) | pipe:(a | pipe:b)`

After:

`1 + 1 | pipe:a | pipe:b` is parsed as `((1 + 1) | pipe:a) | pipe:b`
